name: Chessington Safari Hotel
description: Chessington Safari Hotel is the on-site resort hotel beside the zoo, within walking distance of the park gates. Short-break packages include breakfast, park entry and parking, and rooms include animal-view and Gruffalo, Jumanji and PAW Patrol themes. Rates shown are rough estimates and change a lot by date.

rooms.name: Animal-View Room
rooms.description: Room overlooking the animals; packages include breakfast, entry and parking.

rooms.name: Themed Family Room
rooms.description: Themed room such as Gruffalo, Jumanji or PAW Patrol.

name: Chessington Azteca Hotel
description: Chessington Azteca Hotel was the on-site four-star hotel with an Aztec-temple theme, opened in 2014. It is closed: the last bookable date was 31 October 2026, and it is being converted into a Minecraft World hotel planned for 2027. No rates are available.

rooms.name: Closed
rooms.description: Not bookable. Being converted into a Minecraft World hotel.

name: Premier Inn Chessington
description: Premier Inn Chessington is a budget hotel on Leatherhead Road, a very short walk from the park gates. The hotel says it is less than 200 m away, while another site says about 600 m. Rates shown are rough estimates, and a buffet breakfast costs extra.

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.description: Room for up to two adults and two children.

name: Crowne Plaza London - Kingston
description: Crowne Plaza London - Kingston is an upscale hotel in Kingston Tower, Surbiton, about 6 km from the park, so you would need a car or taxi. A sample rate was about £94 per night for one date. Rates shown are rough estimates.
